reason: Reconcile the stale V21 Release Closure Ledger against trusted-main source and exact-head gate evidence after the final known dependency P0 successor merged. Advance a row only to SOURCE_GATE_CLOSED_RC_PENDING when source closure and applicable exact-head gate evidence are mechanically established.
Keep every Known Finding unresolved for final release until a new fresh-main packaged Windows RC closes its packaged evidence layer.
Record PR #538 as historical evidence only and keep UAT-001/UAT-002 pending/enforced for the new final RC.
Keep formal release, publish, promotion, dependency, workflow, product, runtime and test authority closed.

No source closure inferred from merge-only or test-file-only evidence.
No change outside docs/uat/V21_RELEASE_CLOSURE_LEDGER.md in the implementation.
